# FLX-7002: observed readout does not match its claimed prediction

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

An ObservedReadout's prediction_id or metric_id does not match the PredictionRecord it names. Scoring one metric against another's readout is the failure this refusal exists to make impossible -- readouts are bound to the exact prediction they answer, never the nearest one.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7002
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
